verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only that BugSnag offers an MCP server through SmartBear's smartbear-mcp, with OAuth support. That is the server role: it lets external agents call BugSnag, not BugSnag consume other MCP servers' tools. Nothing in the pack documents BugSnag acting as an MCP client or letting users connect external MCP servers, so this applicable axis has no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
